rv.q: Even uber-talented Bertie Carvel fails to enthrall as baddie Enrico.
The result remains, four centuries on, both easy to follow and hard to swallow.
Bijan Sheibani’s underpowered production proves unequal to the task.
The show has several not-quite-saving graces but it feels incoherent and underpowered...

cn.t: This Spanish Golden Age drama about faith and damnation struggles to connect with modern audiences despite Frank McGuinness's half-updated adaptation, leaving critics largely cold toward its dated themes.
